The Chinese characters for Arthur

As a transliteration, Arthur is usually written 阿瑟 (Ā sè). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

a prefix, hill
瑟
sè

Origin and meaning

Arthur is a Celtic name meaning “bear (of uncertain origin)”.

About the name Arthur

King Arthur, the legendary British ruler of the Round Table, gave the name its heroic tone.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Arthur as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “bear (of uncertain origin)”, is part of the appeal.
